retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic group portrait set against a vast, starry night sky with a warm horizon glow and a thick, framed border.

recipe.visualDefinition: A wide-angle nocturnal scene featuring a group of figures standing in a dark field. The upper two-thirds of the frame is dominated by a deep blue starry sky that transitions into a warm, orange-hued horizon on the right. The entire image is encased in a thin copper-colored inner frame and a thick black outer border, with centered, widely-tracked serif text at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between small human figures and the expansive celestial sky
Color temperature shift from cool deep blue to warm orange horizon
Symmetrical framing using a double-border system
Vertical hierarchy with text floating in the upper atmospheric space
coreInvariants: A starry sky occupying at least 60% of the vertical composition
A thin, contrasting inner border separating the image from a thick outer margin
Extreme letter-spacing on all display typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Figures are positioned in the lower third, appearing small against the landscape to emphasize scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central group of figures provides the grounding anchor for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large display text, moves down through the stars to the figures, and finally to the horizon glow.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space provided by the dark sky and the thick black outer border.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep midnight blue and black (background and borders)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm orange and copper (horizon glow and inner frame)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright stars/horizon and the dark foreground/sky.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the title paired with a sturdier, smaller slab-serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classical Roman serif feel and elegant proportions.
Provides the cinematic, authoritative uppercase look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle night landscape with a group of four people in the lower third. The sky should be filled with stars, with a warm orange glow on the right horizon. Add a thin copper border around the image and a thick black margin outside that.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase serif text in the top center of the sky area. Use extreme tracking (wide spacing). The primary title should be in a light teal color, and the secondary text below it in a terracotta color.

verificationChecks: Is the tracking on the text extremely wide?
Is there a clear color transition from blue to orange in the sky?
Are the figures small in scale relative to the sky?
Is the double-border (thin inner, thick outer) present?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the outer black border
mustRedesign: Do not use modern sans-serif fonts
Do not place text in the lower half of the image
Do not use bright, saturated primary colors
postGenerationChecks: Check that text is perfectly centered horizontally
Ensure the copper border is a consistent thin weight
Verify the sky occupies the majority of the frame
Confirm the color palette remains moody and nocturnal
recipe.reuseFormula: Wide-angle nocturnal landscape + Starry sky dominance + Centered wide-tracked serif typography + Double-border framing.
